title: AllException.Message will crash when an object is null

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: A community-provided PR would be welcomed

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: This may be a good issue for a first-time contributor

body:
The issue is encountered when intermixing `Assert.All` and `Assert.NotNull`

Repro:

```
git clone https://github.com/jnonce/XunitAssertNullRef.git
```

Rather than inform me why my test fails, VSRunner will produce an error.  The actual test will always appear to not have run.
